name: MRDIY
recent: 公司近期有多份大股东权益变动申报，涉及Bee Family Limited、Tan Yu Wei、Tan Yu Yeh等。新闻显示第三季度业绩低于预期，公司采取审慎的门店扩张策略。
notable: 大股东Bee Family Limited及关联方在11月23日至25日连续申报权益变动。
第三季度业绩低于预期。
公司表示采取审慎的门店扩张策略。
risks: 大股东及关联方连续多日申报权益变动，需留意股权结构变化。
第三季度净利同比下滑6.4%，分析师下调预测。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收12.56亿令吉，同比增4.8%，环比微降0.1%；净利1.27亿令吉，同比降6.4%，环比降5.3%；净利率10.1%，低于上季的10.7%。

recent_en: The company recently saw multiple substantial shareholder interest change filings involving Bee Family Limited, Tan Yu Wei, Tan Yu Yeh and others. News indicates Q3 earnings missed expectations, analysts cut forecasts and target prices, and the company is adopting a measured store rollout strategy.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder Bee Family Limited and related parties filed consecutive interest change notices from Nov 23 to 25.
Q3 earnings came in below expectations, with analysts cutting earnings forecasts and target prices.
The company said it is adopting a measured store rollout strategy.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders and related parties filed interest change notices over consecutive days; watch for changes in shareholding structure.
Q3 net income fell 6.4% year-on-year, and analysts cut forecasts.
earnings_en: Q3 2026 revenue was RM1.256 billion, up 4.8% year-on-year and down 0.1% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM127.3 million, down 6.4% year-on-year and 5.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 10.1%, lower than 10.7% in the previous quarter.
